title: One plan catalogue in the master database: yearly agency prices, included users, extra-user price, AI credits, communication caps, add-ons, trial expiry
goal: Define plans and add-ons once, as data the owner can change from the super admin console, and enforce users, AI credits, communication caps and trial expiry everywhere from that one place.
why: Plans are defined six different ways (backend/src/middleware/feature-gate.ts PLAN_DEFAULTS with trial/starter/basic/pro/enterprise; routes/admin.ts PLAN_CATALOG with INR yearly prices and 5/15/100 users; services/ai-pricing.ts allowances; super-admin/src/lib/constants.ts free/starter/pro/enterprise monthly; super-admin tenants/[id]/plan/route.ts seat numbers; landing per-user USD). Seats are never checked on invite (routes/users.ts), trial_ends_at is never read, and trial includes voip_calling. Owner decision 2026-10-14: a flat price per agency per year with included users and a monthly AI credit allowance, plus paid add-ons (extra users, AI credit packs), and SMS/WhatsApp/OTP/calls included with a monthly cap per plan; communication top-ups priced at provider cost + 20%, with cost and margin stored as configuration.
steps: Master 0015 creates the catalogue exactly as READINESS-PLAN 4.2 (TEXT dates, REAL money, INTEGER booleans, UUIDv7 literal ids in the seed): plans; plan_prices (plan_key, market, currency, yearly_price, included_users, extra_user_yearly_price, is_active, valid_from); plan_features; plan_allowances (plan_key, allowance_key, monthly_amount) for ai_credits, sms, whatsapp, otp, call_minutes, email; comm_unit_costs (channel sms|whatsapp|otp|call_minute|phone_number, market, provider, unit_cost REAL, currency, margin_pct REAL DEFAULT 20, effective_from, is_active); addon_products (key, kind extra_user|ai_credit_pack|comm_pack, channel NULL|sms|whatsapp|otp|call_minute, units INTEGER, fixed_price REAL NULL, currency, market, is_active); tenant_addons (id, tenant_id, product_key, quantity, units_granted, period_key NULL for recurring (extra users) or the month for packs, source super_admin_grant|purchase, granted_by, reference, created_at).

Seed (all values are drafts for the owner, marked in a comment row `catalogue_notes`): IN market INR yearly 12000/18000/24000 with included_users 5/15/100 (decided prices) and extra_user_yearly_price 2400/1800/1200 (draft); plan_allowances from READINESS-PLAN 4.2 draft table (AI credits 1000/15000/25000, trial 2000; communication caps there); comm_unit_costs IN from COST-MODEL list prices (SMS Twilio 8.06, WhatsApp Twilio fee + Meta utility 0.595, OTP Twilio Verify 12.90, call_minute and phone_number rows left inactive until the G1 addendum), margin_pct 20; addon_products: ai_credit_pack_5000 fixed_price 250 INR (COST-MODEL 6.4 draft), comm packs sms_100, whatsapp_1000, otp_100 with fixed_price NULL (price computed). Remove voip_calling from trial features (ADR fraud rule). Data fix: plan starter -> basic, free -> trial.

services/plans/catalogue.ts: getCatalogue(env) (KV `plans:v<version>`, 300 s; every admin write bumps the version), getPlanFeatures, getAllowance(env, tenantId, key, periodKey) = plan monthly_amount + units from tenant_addons for that period (comm and AI packs) ; seatLimit(env, tenantId) = included_users + extra_user add-on quantity; getActivePrice(env, plan, market).

services/plans/pricing.ts: commPackPrice(env, channel, market, units) = ceil_to_minor_unit(units * unit_cost * (1 + margin_pct/100)) from the active comm_unit_costs row; addonPrice(product) = fixed_price ?? commPackPrice(...); extraUserPrice(plan, market). Used by the public plans endpoint, super admin and billing (R205/R206), never hardcoded.

feature-gate.ts and getTenantFeatures read plan_features (tenant_feature_flags overrides unchanged); ai-pricing.ts/ai-credits.ts monthly allowance from getAllowance(ai_credits). Delete PLAN_DEFAULTS/PLAN_AI_CREDITS constants once tests are updated.
routes/users.ts invite and reactivate: active users plus pending invites count against seatLimit; at the limit return 402 { code: 'SEAT_LIMIT', limit, used, options: ['upgrade', 'extra_users'] }.
Trial expiry in the daily job set (cron/dispatch.ts from R105): trial past trial_ends_at -> expired (KV entry deleted); login 402 TRIAL_EXPIRED.

routes/admin.ts (super admin, audited, bumps the catalogue version): GET /admin/catalogue; PUT /admin/catalogue/plans/:key (name, features), PUT /admin/catalogue/prices/:id, PUT /admin/catalogue/allowances/:plan, PUT /admin/catalogue/unit-costs/:id (cost and margin), PUT /admin/catalogue/addons/:key; POST /admin/tenants/:id/addons { productKey, quantity, note } (grant: extra users, AI credit pack, comm pack) writes tenant_addons with source super_admin_grant. (R111 builds the rest of the admin API; these endpoints live here because they belong to the catalogue.)

routes/public.ts: GET /api/v1/public/plans?market=IN returns active plans with yearly price, included users, extra-user price, features, AI credits and communication caps, and add-on prices (computed), cached 5 minutes, 60 per minute per IP.
utils/tenant-summary.ts: login summary includes plan key/name, seat limit and used seats.

backend/scripts/seed-local.mjs: give the demo tenant enough users and allowances for the e2e suite (grant extra users and comm packs through tenant_addons rows) so existing specs are not blocked by caps.
tests: backend/test/plan-catalogue.test.ts: features come from plan_features (toggle via the admin PUT, cache invalidated); trial has no voip_calling; basic with 5 active users -> invite 402 SEAT_LIMIT, after a super admin grant of 1 extra user the invite works; AI allowance = plan + granted pack for the current month only; commPackPrice(sms, IN, 100) = 100 * 8.06 * 1.2 = 967.20 and changes when unit_cost or margin_pct changes, with no code change; trial expiry flow; GET /public/plans returns computed add-on prices; starter/free tenants migrated.
acceptance: `grep -rn "starter\|PLAN_CATALOG\|PLAN_DEFAULTS" backend/src` finds nothing outside migrations and comments.
Every price shown or charged is derived from catalogue rows (tests change rows, not code).
Seat limit, extra users and trial expiry enforced (tests).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/settings-team.spec.ts e2e/ai-settings.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: Owner confirms the draft numbers: included users, extra-user prices, AI credits, communication caps, pack sizes, unit costs for the chosen providers, international prices (Q2, Q3).
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.
New ids use generateId() (UUIDv7) from backend/src/utils/uuid.ts. D1 conventions: TEXT ISO dates, REAL money, TEXT JSON, INTEGER booleans.
Round computed prices up to the currency minor unit (paise/cents) and store none of them; compute on read.
Do not touch super-admin or landing here: R112 adds the catalogue editor and top-up grants to the console; R116 renders the pricing from /public/plans.
